summary.text: Kenneth Smoron is the Republican candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 59B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Esther Agbaje (D).
He ran for the same seat in 2024, when Agbaje defeated him, 82.3 percent to 17.4 percent.

paragraphs.text: Kenneth Smoron was born in Spring Valley, Illinois, and earned a bachelor's degree from Illinois State University in 1990.
He has been affiliated with the Log Cabin Republicans.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Smoron said Downtown Minneapolis deserves a representative who supports law enforcement as part of a public safety program.
He listed public safety, stable and environmentally sound energy policy, and food insecurity as key messages, and named energy as the policy area he is most passionate about.
